[u]Overall rating: 9/10[/u]

Gunfire Reborn is a first-person-shooter with rogue-lite elements where you clear 4 stages which are each split into 5-6 levels that culminate in a boss fight. There is a diverse set of characters (each with their unique skills and play-style) along with a plethora of weaponry/upgrades for the player to choose from during each run.

Monster variety is lacking but the combination of character, weapons, perks, talents, and the escalating difficulty setting (Reincarnation) keeps the game-play fresh. There is also an elemental system which interacts with the shields/armour/health of enemies (and the player) in various ways and different elements can combine if you apply both of them on the same target.

The weak aspects of the game are the bland music and lack of quick-save options (you can only save in-between stages by interacting with the campfire which is NOT MENTIONED anywhere).

I played the game solo but the co-op feature exists for multiplying the fun factor even more!
 
[u]TLDR: If you like rogue-like arena shooters with lots of build diversity, Gunfire Reborn is one of the best!![/u]
